entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4084834822776246272: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: distance 111.982 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.059), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 111.982 +/- 6.607 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 8.4092 +/- 0.1972 mas (same row, RUWE 1.58), 42.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 33.520, -13.552 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4084834822776246272 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 37.091 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: radius 37.091 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 573.93 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.08) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4642 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: effective temperature 4642 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.041).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,642 K and log g 2.01 (u1 0.726, u2 0.076): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.01 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 6 published values span log g 2.01 to 2.4, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
